name: Creamy Spinach and Sun-Dried Tomato Turkey Meatball Skillet
why: In-lane stovetop turkey meatballs: browned 8-10 min in the skillet then simmered in a spinach/sun-dried-tomato cream sauce (no oven). Site card publishes 500 cal/serving with a Low Carb badge; structurally low-carb (turkey + spinach + sun-dried tomato + heavy cream + parmesan, no starch base) so ~10g carb estimate clears 35g easily. Mid-band calories. Source blends turkey with ground chicken - REBUILD to all ground turkey. Distinct from the mushroom version (spinach + sun-dried tomato flavor). Scales to 14 servings.
ingredients: 4 cloves garlic, grated + 4 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 teaspoon red crushed chili pepper flakes, optional
Salt and fresh cracked black pepper, to taste
1 cup fresh chopped cilantro (or parsley), divided
5 ounces (150g) jarred sun-dried tomato in oil, drained
nutrition_note: Calories (500) and 'Low Carb' label are from eatwell101's recipe card; the page's beta nutrition table does not publish a numeric carb value, so src_carbs is a structural estimate. Confidence on calories: medium-high; on exact carbs: structural (high that it is <35g). Rebuild the ground-chicken half onto ground turkey.
unmapped: shredded mozzarella (no dairy-mozzarella board home; only generic shredded-cheese or vegan daiya on the board)
